findings.evidenceJa: 藤村先生ルート『虎なんていらねえよ・冬』
findings.governingReading: The joke title is “Who Needs a Tiger? — Winter.”
findings.explanation: The English drops the seasonal subtitle 冬 and leaves the title grammatically malformed.

findings.highlight: We can’t have anyone tricked into confusion in the Q&A corner!
findings.evidenceJa: Ｑ＆Ａコーナーで遭難者を出したらダメなんだからっ。
findings.governingReading: Do not leave people lost or stranded in the Q&A section.
findings.explanation: The English replaces the comic disaster metaphor with a claim that someone was tricked into confusion.

findings.governingReading: “You’ve grown strong, Bloomers.” Rin uses ブルマ as a mocking nickname for Illya.
findings.explanation: Romanizing the ordinary noun as buruma hides the nickname and its costume joke.

findings.highlight: Just go on and explain the situation, buruma.
findings.evidenceJa: いいから説明しろブルマ。
findings.explanation: Rin’s curt dismissal and command are softened, while the nickname remains opaque.

findings.highlight: Osu! There are two ways to get to this bad end!
findings.evidenceJa: うっす！　このバッドエンドにくるルートは二つあるであります！
findings.governingReading: Illya answers in exaggerated underling speech, mixing うっす with the mock-military であります.
findings.explanation: The opening interjection is transliterated, but the comic subordinate register carried by であります disappears.

findings.highlight: Getting shot at after stupidly escaping forward.
findings.evidenceJa: 安易に前に逃げたら撃ち殺されたってヤツですね。
findings.governingReading: The first path is the one where the player fled forward carelessly and was shot dead.
findings.explanation: mirror moon changes completed death, 撃ち殺された, into merely being shot at.

findings.highlight: And a special tip for those that came here without seeing any ending!
findings.evidenceJa: それと、まだ一回もエンディングを見てないのにこっちに来た人にスペシャル情報ー！
findings.governingReading: This utterance is commented out and inactive in the original script.
findings.explanation: mirror moon presents an obsolete first-play tip as active dialogue.

findings.highlight: Um, you can’t clear Rin no matter what you do during your first play.
findings.evidenceJa: えーと、一度目のルートではリンはどうやったって攻略できないの。
findings.governingReading: This utterance is commented out and inactive in the original script.
findings.explanation: mirror moon restores obsolete route-progression information that the controlling script excludes.

findings.highlight: It’ll be smart to fight along with Saber as her Master at least once.
findings.evidenceJa: 一度はおとなしくセイバーのマスターとして、セイバーと戦い抜くコトだけを考えた方が賢明だよー。
findings.governingReading: This entire advice line is commented out and inactive in the original script.
findings.explanation: mirror moon activates obsolete route advice.

findings.highlight: It’ll be smart to fight along with Saber as her Master at least once.
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーと戦い抜くコトだけを考えた方が賢明だよー。
findings.governingReading: The advice says it would be wise to think only about fighting the route through to the end alongside Saber.
findings.explanation: Even within the restored line, the English drops 戦い抜く and だけ, losing completion and exclusive focus.
